---
title: "Case studies"
subtitle: "One question per study, answered with Brunei's public data."
toc: false
listing:
  id: studies
  contents:
    - "[0-9]*.qmd"
    - upcoming.yml
  template: ../_templates/study-cards.ejs
  sort: "number desc"
  fields: [title, description, date, number, topic, status, data-period]
  feed: false
include-after-body: _study-filters.html
---

```{=html}
<!-- Hidden until the script runs, so visitors without JavaScript don't see controls that do nothing. -->
<div class="study-filters" role="search" hidden>
  <label for="study-search" class="visually-hidden">Search case studies</label>
  <input id="study-search" type="search" placeholder="Search case studies" autocomplete="off">
  <div class="filter-row">
    <div class="chips" role="group" aria-label="Filter by topic"></div>
    <div class="sort">
      <label for="study-sort">Sort by</label>
      <select id="study-sort">
        <option value="published">Newest published</option>
        <option value="data">Latest data</option>
        <option value="number">Study number</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<p class="filter-count" aria-live="polite"></p>
```

::: {#studies}
:::
